subject: Weekly leadership snapshot — priorities, blockers, and QBR asks
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: exec-distro@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-28T08:15:00Z
Subject: Weekly leadership snapshot — priorities, blockers, and QBR asks

Team — quick morning note to align ahead of Friday's QBR dry run. Short wins, risks, and asks below. Please reply with owners/timelines inline.

WINS
- Redwood Dedicated: completed final throughput tuning for the nvlink pool; internal perf tests show 12% lower p95 for chat workloads.
- Onboarding: three new PLG pilots converted to paid in the last 30 days (two in Retail, one in Health).

RISKS
- Model onboarding backlog: Research pipeline is ~6 models behind schedule; this threatens the model catalog coverage for our mid-Market push. Need a go/no-go by next Tue.
- QBR readiness: QBR one-pager still has gaps on cost delta and routing policy outcomes.

ASKS / NEXT STEPS
1) Laura — can you finalize the customer wins slide and confirm ARR figures for the three pilots? (target: Wed EOD)
2) Markus — please own the model onboarding triage plan. Can your team allocate 1 FTE from infra for 3 weeks to unblock the backlog?
3) Maya — ops: validate the nvlink perf numbers with production traces and surface any anomalies (target: Thu noon).
4) Jonas — compile the SLAs and incident history to justify the Dedicated SLA ask in the deck.

Attachments: qbr_onepager_draft_v2.pdf (draft) and okrs-snapshot-0307-2027.xlsx

Thanks — short replies welcome.

— Rishi
Director, Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-28T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Weekly leadership snapshot — priorities, blockers, and QBR asks

Rishi — thanks for the concise note. Quick replies inline: 

> RISKS — Model onboarding backlog: Research pipeline is ~6 models behind schedule; this threatens the model catalog coverage for our mid-Market push. Need a go/no-go by next Tue.

Agree this is critical. I'll propose a short triage: 1) freeze non-essential experiments, 2) prioritize two models required for mid-market demos, 3) start a targeted QA sprint.

I can free one infra FTE for 3 weeks starting Mon Apr 5, but we should be explicit about what that FTE will do. Recommend: kernel tuning for two top-priority models and migrating their validation harness to the new CI runners.

Maya — can your team provide the production traces Markus needs for validation?

On the QBR deck: I can add a short slide showing the experimental cost delta table if Laura can provide the final pilot ARR numbers.

— Markus
VP, Serving Runtime

Folks — quick updates from GTM and a deck ask.

1) ARR confirmation: the three pilots total $185k ARR annualized. I'll drop a line to finance to get the official number in the pack by Wed EOD.
2) Customer wins slide: I'll add two short customer quotes (anonymized) and a short bullet on retention signals.
3) QBR one-pager: the cost delta callout needs a single chart that clearly shows "before vs after" routing policy changes. Can someone on infra/ops produce the policy delta numbers by Thu 3pm PST?

Attaching a placeholder with current slide order: qbr_onepager_draft_v2.pdf

If we want to highlight a go/no-go for model onboarding in the QBR, we should include a mitigation plan and the customer impact of delaying the two mid-market models. Markus — can you draft the mitigation bullets?

— Laura
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

- Laura Bennett — final ARR and customer quotes for slides — Wed 2027-03-30 EOD — qbr_onepager_draft_v2.pdf updated in Drive
- Markus Klein — model onboarding triage + mitigation bullets — draft for review — Tue 2027-03-29 EOD — include explicit FTE allocation plan
- Maya Srinivasan — production traces + routing policy delta numbers (ops validation) — Thu 2027-03-31 15:00 PST — attach trace snippets and summary
- Rishi Malhotra — consolidate slide deck and run Friday dry run (10:00 PST) — Fri 2027-04-02 10:00 PST — upload vFinal

I've created a short checklist in the Drive folder and linked the hubspot record (HUBSPOT-84321) so our customer-facing numbers are traceable. If anyone needs to adjust dates, reply-all with availability.

See you on the dry run — thanks for quick turnarounds.

— Jonas
